name: io.github.cbdmaul/metasploit-mcp
description: Metasploit MCP Server - controlled access to Metasploit Framework functionality (exploits, payloads, sessions, listeners) via the Model Context Protocol.

environment_variables.name: MSF_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Password for the Metasploit RPC service (msfrpcd -P ...).

environment_variables.name: MSF_SERVER
environment_variables.description: Host of the Metasploit RPC service.

environment_variables.name: MSF_PORT
environment_variables.description: Port of the Metasploit RPC service.

environment_variables.name: MSF_SSL
environment_variables.description: Whether the Metasploit RPC service uses SSL ('true' or 'false').

environment_variables.name: PAYLOAD_SAVE_DIR
environment_variables.description: Directory where generated payloads are written (defaults to ~/payloads).
